recorded: Both originals ran unchanged, the JavaScript version with Node.js 26 as node monte-carlo-routewise.js and the Python version with Python 3.15 as python3 monte-carlo-routewise.py. Their random draws are unseeded, so each printed value is compared within 0.1 of the exact percentile or mean of the distribution, and the header accepts the Brazilian thousands separator the JavaScript version prints and the default one the Python version prints. Each original passed 300 runs.

cases.name: simulates 10,000 schedules and prints P50, P85, P95, and the mean in weeks, within one printed decimal of the exact distribution
